intel: ipu3: Increase CIO2 buffer number [Issue] There was random failure to get capture buffer issue when doing full CTS tests. [Root Cause] The root cause is that there are 4 CIO2 buffers held by IMGU for lastPixelBuffer and pixelBuffer were held by each IMGU pipes (VIDEO and STILL). So only increasing 1 buffer wasn't enough. BUG=b:117375872 TEST=Build and deploy package to platform and camera works Change-Id: I2a0e778de698643f5315a3a1a8e3d79a2f3b0a43 Signed-off-by: Qingwu Zhang <qingwu.zhang@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1290175 Commit-Ready: Jian Xu Zheng <jian.xu.zheng@intel.com> Tested-by: Wei Meng <wei.meng@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>

shill: Only list net/ source files once in BUILD.gn CL:947318 modifies shill's build such that net/ source files are built twice--once for shill, and once for a shared DLL using different compilation flags. It is inconvenient to insist that developers remember that newly-added net/ source files must be specified twice in the build file, however. This change instead places the net source files in a "net_sources" list that is used by both targets. BUG=chromium:897985 TEST=`cros_workon_make --board ${BOARD} shill --test` succeeds. Adding a non-existent source file to net_sources causes the build to fail. Change-Id: I6da7f1e46d36dcd29a7e93fc4750a24deda90ebe Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1295569 Commit-Ready: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Tested-by: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>

CRAS: Set default wake_ts in set_input_dev_wake_ts When an input device is in an error state, set_input_dev_wake_ts should set a default wait_ts for the input device instead of letting audio_thread use device's past wake_ts to calculate next wake_ts. This behavior will trigger a busyloop. BUG=b:118048493 TEST=Run $ cras_test_client --capture_f /tmp/test.raw to test capture functionality. Change-Id: I7693f6d4904745c9dad701d495effbd9fd86fb59 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1295534 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Chih-Yang Hsia <paulhsia@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Chih-Yang Hsia <paulhsia@chromium.org>

CRAS: fix ramping for large block size stream Ramping takes an initial scaler and an increment. When the block size is large, the incremented scaler will be greater than software volume scaler. This causes a pop noise in the beginning of playback. To fix this, we need to pass an upper limit to the scale ops. BUG=b:113041524 TEST=unittest TEST=run cras_test_client --playback_f /usr/local/autotest/cros/audio/fix_440_16_half.raw --block 4800 there is no noise in the beginning. Change-Id: I2f2186d6af64b015335e26d093984ca737cadbf9 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1270329 Commit-Ready: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Tested-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org>
